name: lock
description: Manage Lock realms, realm policies, OAuth clients, protected APIs with scopes, and social login providers.

accessToken.description: Management API access token; used for the Admin API too unless adminAccessToken is set. Mutually exclusive with client credentials.

adminAccessToken.description: Optional separate token addressed to the Admin API with realms:read and realms:write.

baseUrl.description: Master realm issuer URL, e.g. https://lock.example, without /api.

clientId.description: Master realm OAuth client ID. Tokens are obtained lazily for each API and renewed before expiry.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret. Grant read/write scopes for the resource types being managed: realms, clients, resources and social-providers. Each resource type obtains its own scoped token lazily.

tokenEndpointAuthMethod.description: Authentication method for the provider's OAuth client: client_secret_basic (default) or client_secret_post.

accessTokenLifetime.description: Seconds an access token stays valid.

allowedRedirectDomains.description: Hosts a redirect URI may point at; `*` allows any.

allowedRedirectSchemes.description: URI schemes a redirect URI may use.

autoProvision.description: Create a realm user on their first verified upstream sign-in.

clientCredentialsLifetime.description: Seconds a token issued to a machine client stays valid.

defaultScopes.description: Scopes every client is granted without asking.

dynamicRegistration.description: Whether a client may register itself through RFC 7591.

emailVerificationRequired.description: Whether an unverified address blocks sign-in.

firstPartyTrusted.description: Whether the first-party client skips the consent screen.

idTokenLifetime.description: Seconds an ID token stays valid.

linkByVerifiedEmail.description: Link an upstream identity to a local user with the same verified email address.

loginMethods.description: The ways an identity may sign in: `password`, `passkey`, `social`.

mfaRequirement.description: When a second factor is demanded: `never`, `if_enrolled`, `always`.

optionalScopes.description: Scopes a client may request on top; `*` allows any of the catalog.

passwordHistory.description: How many previous passwords may not be reused.

passwordMaxAgeDays.description: Days before a password must be changed; `0` never expires.

passwordMixedCase.description: Whether a password must mix upper and lower case.

passwordNumbers.description: Whether a password must carry a digit.

passwordSymbols.description: Whether a password must carry a symbol.

passwordUncompromised.description: Whether a password is checked against known breaches.

recoveryCodes.description: How many recovery codes an identity is issued.

refreshTokenLifetime.description: Seconds a refresh token stays valid.

sessionAbsoluteLifetime.description: Seconds a sign-in session lives at most, however often it is refreshed.

sessionTokenRefreshSkew.description: Seconds before expiry at which a session token is refreshed early.

sessionTokenTtl.description: Seconds a session token stays valid before it is refreshed.

tokenExchange.description: Whether the RFC 8693 token exchange grant is served.

totpSecretLength.description: Bytes of a generated TOTP secret.

totpWindow.description: Time steps either side of now a TOTP code is accepted in.

trustedClients.description: Client ids that skip the consent screen.

description.description: Human readable scope description. Omit to clear the existing description.

clientId.description: Upstream OAuth client ID, required for every driver.

clientSecret.description: Write-only Google, GitHub or OIDC secret. Required on creation. Omitted, null or blank values retain the previous secret, including in state; credentials cannot be cleared through this API.

issuer.description: Required for OIDC. Omission on update retains the stored issuer.

keyId.description: Required for Apple. Omission on update retains the stored key ID.

privateKey.description: Write-only Apple private key. Required for Apple on creation. Omitted, null or blank values retain the previous key, including in state; credentials cannot be cleared through this API.

teamId.description: Required for Apple. Omission on update retains the stored team ID.

lock:index:Client.description: A realm's OAuth client. Import using realm-slug/client-id. The secret is available at creation and preserved during refresh; importing does not disclose an existing secret.

backchannelLogoutUri.description: Back-channel logout endpoint. Omit or set an empty string to clear it.

realm.description: Realm slug. Changing it replaces the client.

tokenEndpointAuthMethod.description: Client authentication method. Changing it replaces the client so its credentials remain consistent with Pulumi state.

lock:index:ProtectedResource.description: A protected API resource and its authoritative set of scopes. Import using realm-slug/resource-uuid.

identifier.description: A path relative to the realm issuer or an absolute URI identifying the API resource.

realm.description: Realm slug. Changing it replaces the protected resource.

scopes.description: Authoritative scope definitions keyed by scope value. Omitting scopes or using an empty map removes all scopes, including scopes added outside Pulumi.

lock:index:Realm.description: A Lock realm. Import using its slug. Only explicitly supplied settings are managed; omitted settings retain their server values.

domain.description: Realm hostname, without a scheme or path. DNS verification status is exposed as domainStatus.

settings.description: Realm policy overrides. Removing an override stops managing it and retains its server value; the API has no reset-to-default operation. Set an explicit value to change it.

slug.description: Immutable realm identifier. Changing it replaces the realm and its contents.

lock:index:SocialProvider.description: A realm social login provider. Import using realm-slug/provider-UUID. The API never returns credentials; imports cannot recover them and refresh preserves credentials already in state.

config.description: Driver configuration. The entire output object is secret to protect retained write-only credentials. Omitted optional values retain their stored values on update.

driver.description: Upstream driver. Changing it replaces the provider; replacement deletes first when the realm and key are unchanged.
